breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go build.

mindset.body: Houston held the Colts to three points on Thursday night. No cheap yards, no lapses, no coasting into the weekend. Friday is where most people let up. You don't. Close the week the way you opened it: first call early, every lead gets a next step, and Monday already has your name on it. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Friday, the day of Venus: run this right after Morning Charge. It's about 40° and overcast, so keep the RipStick finisher inside or bundle up. Smooth, controlled reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Senate passes the Ali Boxing Revival Act
items.body: The Senate unanimously passed the Muhammad Ali American Boxing Revival Act.

Friday is Frigg's day in the north and Venus's day in the planetary week (vendredi, viernes). The old magicians worked Venus hours for love, harmony and persuasion. Charm is a force. Use it on purpose.
The Corpus Hermeticum says that what you hold steadily in the mind's eye shapes what you become. The Hermeticists didn't treat imagination as fantasy. They treated it as a tool.

The 14th-century anchoress wrote 'All shall be well, and all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well' after visions during a near-fatal illness. Calm under pressure isn't denial. It's a decision.

techDemo.title: Tech Demo
techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: @KutaTweaks posted a PC-gamer checklist for removing Windows AI features and trimming background overhead, aiming for higher FPS and lower latency.
techDemo.author: @KutaTweaks
techDemo.note: No new bookmarks since Nov 17, so this rotates an older real one (posted Nov 10). The full steps are behind the post's link, so the lesson stays general.

lesson.oneLiner: Fewer things running in the background means more of the machine goes to the game.
beats: Check Task Manager > Startup apps and turn off anything you don't need at boot.
Turn off AI and assistant features you don't use in Windows Settings, one at a time.
Make a restore point before any tweak pack, and change one thing at a time so you know what helped.
Same at work: cut the noise from your day and the important calls get your full speed.
lesson.takeaway: Remove the drag before you add more power.
